attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the authoritative/forwarding DNS resolver for the shared private network (10.100.234.0/24): it answers inventory.internal with node2's address (10.100.234.11) via a static-host-mapping, and forwards all other queries to upstream resolvers (1.1.1.1, 9.9.9.9) via pdns_recursor. Configured node2 and node3 (Ubuntu 16.04) to resolve through node1 by fixing systemd-networkd's DHCP-pushed DNS (which was overriding resolv.conf via the platform's 50-antrieb-dhcp.network file) with DNS=10.100.234.10 / UseDNS=false, backing up the original, plus a resolvconf head entry and dhclient supersede directive for defense in depth. Verified inventory.internal and external names (example.com, cloudflare.com) resolve correctly from both client nodes. Then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes: captured baseline boot_id and DNS health, issued native reboots, polled until each node's exec access returned, confirmed changed boot_id, and re-verified DNS forwarding/resolution and config persistence (VyOS config.boot, Ubuntu network files) after each restart.
